criteria.justification: Core functions are covered but ERP integration is batch-only and scale evidence is limited.
criteria.evidence: A hosted web application will provide ticket queues, email ingestion and a standard CRM connector; ERP integration uses a nightly CSV export.

criteria.justification: A clear short schedule exists, but contingency and acceptance thresholds are missing.
criteria.evidence: The proposed eight-week schedule allocates one week to discovery, four to configuration, two to testing and one to launch.

criteria.justification: Lowest transparent three-year price; exclusions should still be priced before award.
criteria.evidence: Three-year total cost is USD 156,000, including a fixed implementation fee and three annual subscriptions.

criteria.justification: Only basic transport, backup and role controls are specified.
criteria.evidence: The application uses HTTPS and daily backups; access is controlled by passwords and administrator-managed user roles.

criteria.justification: Business-hours response and small reference projects provide limited enterprise assurance.
criteria.evidence: Support is provided on business days from 09:00 to 17:00, with a one-business-day response target.

risks: Security and compliance evidence is limited.
Aggressive timeline has no explicit contingency.
Limited experience at the requested scale.
overall_summary: Lowest price and a short schedule, offset by limited compliance detail, integration depth and support coverage.
